objects.name: fee_account
objects.description: A pupil's fee account, a bursary fund, or a term's tuition income — this school's own nouns for the same two roles a membership ledger fills with baskets and paybills.

objects.name: posting
objects.description: One movement against a fee account: an invoice raised, a payment received, a bursary applied, or a correction reversing one of them.

indexes.name: invoice
indexes.description: Finds every posting raised by one invoice, which is how a bursar reconciles a term.
